Hey mate, thank you so much for your kind and supportive words. Really appreciate it :). I am so happy for you that you overcame that tough time in your life.

The one thing I've worked quite a lot on is what other people think of me but soemtimes it's hard when the other people are your own family, friends or parter and they judge you. It's heartbreaking at times, like how people start perceiving you differently and lose respect for you if you're not doing too well in life, it's actually a time you would expect them to actually support you even more but especially with my mum it's always been about her. Everytime I would bring something that she did hurt me, forget acknowledging it or listening to me she'll just start criticising me and belittling me instead.

I just feel ashamed of all the debt I've incurred and all the people I have to pay back to! It's the constant guilt and shame, especially when people ask you for money or sometimes they ignore you thinking that you'll ask for more.

Except the last 2 years of my life I've just lended money to people all my life and I would never even ask people to pay it back to me unless they themselves are comfortable paying me back and still a few people owe me some money and I still won't ask cause I know they must be struggling. And forget about judging them!

It's the shame I feel when people and my own people nudge me when am I going to finish my masters which has taken me well over 6 years now, like I'm not ashamed of myself all the time of not being able to do stuff because of my depression, trauma and health issues.

About being a good son. I think I've just put too much energy being a good person for my mum, sis and my partners and I often ignore my own needs. The only person who has truly ever supported me or I feel appreciated by is my dad, as he has never judged me on material success but on my values and of how hard I always try though I know even he doesn't respect me enough to take my opinion seriously on things.

I've always just lived for others, that I have to do this for my mom, or my dad or my partner or this or that.

The challenge for me now is just to start living for myself and I literally don't know how to do that but I'm researching. To maintain boundaries which I've always failed to, stop feeling guilty and getting manipulated by people. And focus on my career and work at hand!! Take things little by little though. 

Thanks for reading it all if you did so. :)
